authorization: Root authorized this one rejection-only inspection after ordinal13. Native owner retains process/tree control. No added native stages, settings, cases or acceptance authority.
logical_basis: Original R1 is a conjunction of 1008 fixed predicates. These 144 predicates use complete N16384 and N32768 results; a later N65536 result cannot change any of them. Therefore any failure rejects that same prerequisite without evaluating the other 864.

checkpoint.trigger: After successful natural closure, exact receipt, complete lossless archive and verified duplicate pruning of ordinal13; do not inspect partial RGB files.
checkpoint.sensor_ids: s000001 through s000024 in original order
checkpoint.primary_order: Two complete identical sensor-major blocks, with all N directions per sensor; each N is a separately defined full domain. No nested-prefix interpretation.
checkpoint.normalization: Each block and sensor: pi*sum(N radiance values)/N/100, once; sky RGB then solar RGB.
checkpoint.assembly: Unchanged reference_stream.assemble: diffuse + (full solar - matched black-opaque ab0 solar) + authenticated original finite direct; block means then two-block mean. No clamp.
checkpoint.denominator: Complete two-block N32768 component mean, exactly as original reference_stream.compare; never lower-N or total when comparing components.

decisions.failed_any_144: Reject prerequisite; native owner stops further engine work using existing owned process-tree control. Retain all 144 values and failures. Remaining 864: NOT EVALUATED.
decisions.negative_assembly: Reject prerequisite with separate negative-result diagnosis; preserve signed values, do not clamp.
decisions.integrity_or_resource_failure: Stop with separate integrity/resource error; do not report a numerical tolerance failure or successful inspection.
decisions.passed_all_144: Continue only the original schedule, ordinal22 R1 gate and original conditional R2 gates. No estimator, reference-family, candidate, accuracy or release acceptance.
decisions.raced_later_stage: Record actual observed state and exact original output/record hashes. An interrupted ordinal14 is partial/cancelled; a naturally successful closed stage is successful but unused. Do not reclassify successful evidence or silently delete partials.
decisions.remaining_label: NOT EVALUATED, not necessarily NOT EXECUTED: some B data may already exist.

For N in (16384,32768), ab in (0,8,9): summary[(N,ab)] = R.expected(S.read_archive(A4116, exact_archive_receipt, unchanged_remaining_deadline), N, 100).
For N in (16384,32768), ab in (8,9): assembly[(N,ab)] = S.assemble(summary[(N,ab)], summary[(N,0)], authenticated_original_finite_rgb).
Require exactly all 144 distinct expected (label,sensor_id,component) keys. Preserve every row, all negative diagnostics and false qualification flags.
Return reject_prerequisite if any comparison fails or assembly is negative; otherwise continue_original_schedule. Inspector neither launches nor cancels native processes.
